decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm">The flat roof of the two storey
extension hereby permitted shall not be used at any time as a balcony, roof
terrace, roof garden or external amenity area, other than for essential
maintenance or repair purposes. No balustrades, railings, privacy screens or
other means of enclosure shall be erected on or around the flat roof for the
purpose of facilitating its use as an external amenity area.<o:p></o:p></p>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed on the western elevation of the two storey side extension hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px 0px 0cm;">26/V2/103; 26/E/004;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px 0px 0cm;">26/E/001; 26/E/002; 26/E/003; 26/V2/102; 26/SPP/000; 26/V2/101; 26/E/00; Reasonable Exception Statement</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm">Prior to the first use of the aside
decking, privacy screening shall be installed along the western and eastern flanks
to a height of 1.6m from the bottom of the terrace in accordance with submitted
plans 26/2/101. The screening shall be retained and maintained thereafter for
the lifetime of the development.<o:p></o:p></p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Conversion of garage to habitable room; Replace garage door with window in front elevation; Two storey side to rear extension; Alterations to roof to form end gable and rear dormer; Roof lights in front roof slope; Raised terrace to rear
